suggestions.rationale: Mapping Expansion Batch ME-16 adds this relationship only as the user-approved bounded clinical proposition. The cited cross-national World Mental Health Surveys found specific phobia associated with elevated comorbidity with depressive and other mental disorders without establishing onset order or direction. Require independently diagnosed specific phobia and separately established depressive disorder; the cited cross-national survey reported specific phobia comorbidity with other mental disorders and does not establish onset order or direction. Preserve other anxiety disorders, depressive disorders, substance use, medical causes of episodic symptoms, and avoidance attributable to other conditions as competing explanations. Do not infer a depressive disorder from phobic avoidance, distress, or impairment alone, and do not treat this population-level association as proof that specific phobia caused an individual's depressive disorder. The cited literature supports only this constrained proposition and does not, by itself, establish an individual medical nexus.
